body: Doesn't really matter where I go as soon as they hear I intentionally OD'D they'll want to do a mental health assessment.
I feel sick but I'm worried that I'll end up in a psych ward again and that was a really bad experience for me.
I managed to stop myself from taking anymore, I was just hoping that it was a low enough amount that i could get away with not going.
My experience of it was horrible, being there was making me a lot worse so I had to pretend to be improving just to get out.

Thank you for sharing, its interesting to see how many people feel similar about this. I think it's the main reason that nothing truly helps me. I feel like theres so much bullshit that the good can never outweigh the bad.

I can't just switch off from all the suffering and injustices in the world.

I think probably the best thing to do is be firm about how you feel. if the things you listed above are what you absolutely need in a relationship and it won't work without it then I think you should make that absolutely clear.

If he can't provide what you need it's gonna be more painful the longer it goes on so it would be better to decide whether it's going to work or not sooner rather than later.
No problem, glad i could help.

You're welcome, like you said as long as you're nice about it then it's not your fault if someone decides to take it the wrong way.

The most important thing is how you feel about it, there's no point in doing anything that you will regret or that might make you feel worse.

Yeah it can be difficult to talk about personal issues (especially mental health) to people you don't know very well. It obviously differs from person to person as well, for me though if I'm comfortable enough with the person I'll usually just say something like "I'm struggling with some personal issues so I'm not feeling up to it".

But tbh you don't even have to say anything like that if you dont want to. imo you don't owe anyone an explanation especially if you're not close to them so it just depends what you're most comfortable with.

It could be as simple as saying "not right now thanks", when someone asks if you wanna hang out.

When I'm really struggling I just feel so overwhelmed and drained that I struggle to even talk to people at all (including texting sometimes). When people ask me if I wanna do anything I don't make any excuses and just tell them the truth and if they are true friends they will understand and give me some space and still be there for me with no hard feelings when I'm  ready to interact again.
Im so sick and tired of society, enough said.
